name: Scott Langston
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov rule (scottlangston.org, 12 Nov 2026): the site is an integrative counselling practice (CBT, IFS, DBT, solution-focused therapy, MBCT, ACT) with limited online capacity while he works as a high-school counsellor at the American School of Bucharest; its Mindfulness page describes mindfulness only as a tool used within counselling, and the blog is therapy-focused. Psychotherapy and counselling are out of scope, and no meditation class, retreat or other spiritual practice of his own is offered, so nothing is left to list.
